Overview
Bachelor in Artificial Intelligence with honours offers in Faculty of Artificial Intelligence, UTM is a 3-year
program and is designed to provide students with a broad background in the principles, methodologies, an

d
applications of AI. The program gives students the knowledge and skills to overcome and cope with the
problems and opportunities of the emerging field of AI. The curriculum will provide a foundational course in
mathematics and computer science and core AI courses. This comprises a set of courses that will
particularly concentrate on the field of AI, including machine learning, deep learning, natural language
processing, computer vision, generative AI, Responsible AI, and ethics and many more.

Elective courses
cover advanced topics in AI and AI applications in different domains. Students can choose up to 11 elective
courses as per their interest or aspiration. The program emphasizes industry infused and hands-on
experience via practical training, projects, and internships. Through this, the students will get a chance to
apply AI techniques to real-world problems. Such hands-on experience will surely help the students gain
critical thinking, problem-solving, and teamwork skills. Upon c

ompletion of the Bachelor in Artificial
Intelligence with Honours program at UTM, graduates are well-equipped to pursue careers in various
sectors such as technology, healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and more. They may work as AI engineers,
data scientists, machine learning specialists, research scientists, AI consultants, or pursue further studies at
the graduate level. The program aims to produce graduates capable of contributing to the development and
application of AI technologies to addr

ess societal challenges and drive innovation.

Learning Outcomes
Upon completion of the program requirements, the graduate will be able to:
Acquire comprehensive theory and technical knowledge in the field of artificial intelligence.
Design creative, innovative and effec

tive problem solutions based on artificial intelligence technologies.
Apply various artificial intelligence techniques to solve a broad range of complex and multidisciplinary
problems.
Collaborate effectively with stakeholders based on professional practice.
Communicate effectively both in oral and written to multiple stakeholders.
Utilise artificial intelligence based digital skills in solving a broad range of complex and multidisciplinary
problems.
Utilise artificial intelligence based numerac

y skills in solving a broad range of complex and
multidisciplinary problems.
Demonstrate leadership talent, ability to work independently, collaboratively and taking responsibility in
the artificial intelligence profession.
Enhance self-capabilities through lifelong learning and professional development.
Apply entrepreneurial skill in developing artificial intelligence based innovative solutions.
Adhere to ethics and professional practice.
